description:
In childhood, Woo-Yeon, who developed from a beta to a zealous omega, ran away with his mother to avoid his father who was sure to sell him out because of gambling debts. After that, he received a scholarship to pay for his mother’s hospital bills and worked part-time every day. Then, he happened to come across Jeong-Han, the son of the owner of the mansion where his mother used to work, at a school opening ceremony. Jeong-Han pretends to know him and drinks with him, and even buys him meals to do group projects together.

 *“Are you always that interested in other people?”
“Have you forgotten? I told you I was interested in my senior.”*

He tried to push him away, thinking it was a joke, but eventually received help from Jeong-Han.

 *“Jeong-Han, thank you for today. I won’t forget you for the rest of my life. I’ll repay you no matter what.”
“Anything? Then sleep with me like this once in a while.”
“…What?”*

Will Woo-Yeon ever be able to escape the dangerous yet affectionate Jeong-Han?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
